calculation.description: For each tradable instrument, estimate rolling 60-day beta to the equal-weight cross-asset benchmark, compute its 10-day return residual to the benchmark move, and invert the residual so underperformers receive higher scores. Beta and benchmark information use only completed observations through the signal date.

validation.regime_notes: Full-history admission passes the benchmark gates, with complete cross-sectional coverage. Predictive power is strongly regime-dependent: IC is negative in 2020-2026 and strongly positive in 2027-2029 and the recent 252 observations. The 20-day decay is negligible; use only at a 10-day decision horizon and conservatively pending correlation audit.
